title: flowguard_declare_contract
description: Declare evidence-bound ProofGraph contract claims for the current change; advisory, never alters review acceptance.

claims.description: Claims to declare, each covered by an implementation check at the current revision.

checkId.description: Active check whose implementation attempt is the claim evidence.

critical.description: Whether the claim is critical (default true).

counterexampleCheckId.description: Optional check whose FAILURE would contradict this claim (adversarial falsification).

authority.description: Approved GOVERNING source for this claim (ticket/plan/architecture). Only a resolved authority classifies the claim as `fact`; without one it is a NOT_VERIFIED assumption. Validation evidence is never a governing authority.

structuralSurface.description: Optional cross-artifact consistency surface whose assertion also covers this claim. Becomes required positive evidence and is bound to the surface digest, so the claim goes STALE when that surface changes.
